plan.major: Fisheries and Water Resources (Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences)
plan.notes: Source: official UWSP Sample Graduation Plan, College of Natural Resources (file Grad-Plan-Fisheries-and-Aquatic-Sciences-1.pdf), printed 'Catalog Fall 2026', updated March 2026; filed under 2026-2027 as the current catalog at collection time. Fisheries and Water Resources (BS), Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences Option. The plan states it 'is not meant to serve as an official document' and refers students to their adviser and the University Catalog (https://catalog.uwsp.edu/). Credit ranges and 'or' options resolved per course choice_note (first-listed option used); the modeled total is 123. 'Water Resources Elective' slots (3 cr each; no more than 6 credits of WATR 381 Internship in Water may fulfill water electives) and CGER slots are modeled as choice slots, never as real courses. Prerequisites are not listed on the plan; see the catalog. The required Summer Field Experience is modeled as one 7-credit choice slot (7-course bundle at 7 cr or NRES 475 at 8 cr), following the plan's printed sequence. 2.25 GPA in the major required for graduation (2.0 cumulative). (Fa)=offered fall only; (Sp)=spring only; (Su)=summer only.
